tactics:
induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
    congr 1
    funext o
    cases o with
    | none => exact ih
    | some b => rw [ih (acc := b :: acc), ih (acc := [b])]; simp [Functor.map_map]

induction l with
  | nil => intro acc; simp [List.filterMapM.loop]
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro acc
    simp only [List.filterMapM.loop, map_bind]
    apply bind_congr
    intro o
    cases o <;> simp only [] <;> first | exact ih | (rw [ih (acc := _ :: acc), ih (acc := [_])]; simp [Functor.map_map])
